title: chore(deps): deduplicate lockfile
body:
**Summary**

deduplicate installed packages in the repo (mainly using the https://github.com/scinos/yarn-deduplicate tool).
I couldn't find a tool that highlighted duplicates, but this is already an improvement, especially in preparation of more packages being added later.

**Result**

Highlights:

* only one version of babel in the whole project
* saves ~100MB of node\_modules (950MB -> 850MB)

There's probably even more simplifications possible, but these I saw easily possible.
